result.instructions: Tools for MxToolbox, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Does example.com have a valid SPF record and a DMARC policy?"; "Is 203.0.113.10 listed on any email blocklists?"; "Show the MX records for our domain and explain any warnings.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MxToolbox data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mxtoolbox_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mxtoolbox_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mxtoolbox_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mxtoolbox_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mxtoolbox_dns_lookup
tools.title: DNS lookup
tools.description: Run a simple DNS lookup for a domain: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, A, AAAA, TXT, SOA, PTR, ASN or DNS. Returns passed, warning, failed and timeout checks. Uses the daily simple-lookup quota (64 a day on Free). Quotas reset daily at 00:00 UTC. MxToolbox API: GET /Lookup/{command}.

argument.description: Domain name or IP address. The dkim command needs domain:selector, e.g. example.com:default.

tools.name: mxtoolbox_network_lookup
tools.title: Network lookup
tools.description: Run a network lookup: blacklist (email blocklists for an IP or domain), SMTP, HTTP/HTTPS, ping, TCP port check, or trace route. Uses the daily network quota, which is 0 on the Free plan (needs Basic or higher). The tcp command needs a port. MxToolbox API: GET /Lookup/{command}.

command.description: Network lookup command. Needs a paid plan.

argument.description: Domain name or IP address. The dkim command needs domain:selector, e.g. example.com:default.

port.description: Port number, e.g. 25, 80 or 443. Required for tcp.

tools.name: mxtoolbox_list_monitors
tools.title: List monitors
tools.description: List the monitors on the account with their status, failing checks, warnings and tags. Filter by lookup command, monitored name, or tag. Needs a paid plan (Basic or higher). MxToolbox API: GET /Monitor.

command.description: Filter by lookup command, e.g. mx or blacklist.

name.description: Filter by the monitored domain name or IP address.

tag.description: Filter by tag name, e.g. production.

tools.name: mxtoolbox_get_usage
tools.title: Get API usage
tools.description: Show today's API usage: simple (DNS) and network lookups used, and the plan maximums for each. Works on every plan. MxToolbox API: GET /Usage.
